note: Generated from checks/*/*.yaml by scripts/generate-checks.js; the YAML is where a check is authored, this is only how a process reads one without a parser. Run `npx grunt checks` rather than editing it.

unreachable-function.message: A stylesheet function is called only from functions that are themselves never reached, so it can never run. Remove it, or call it from a template.

unused-function.message: A stylesheet function is never called in any expression across the corpus. Remove it or call it.

unused-named-template.message: A named template is never invoked via xsl:call-template from anything that runs. Remove it or call it.

unused-variable.message: A variable is declared but never referenced by $name across the corpus. Remove it or use it.

broken-href.message: The @href names no file on disk, so no processor will load this stylesheet. Point it at the module, or restore the file.

circular-import.message: The stylesheet pulls in itself, or a module that pulls it back, through xsl:import or xsl:include, which is a static error. Break the cycle.

confusing-variable-and-node.message: A variable name is used bare as a node selector. Use $name syntax to reference the variable.

count-compared-to-zero.message: count(...) is compared with 0 to test existence, which walks the whole sequence. Test existence directly instead (exists()/empty() on XSLT 2.0+, boolean()/not() on 1.0).

leaking-result-namespace.message: The xsl:stylesheet declares a namespace prefix used only in stylesheet logic, which a literal result element copies into the output. Add the prefix to exclude-result-prefixes.

name-compared-to-string.message: name() or local-name() is compared with a string, which is prefix-fragile and slower than a node test. Match the element with a node test on the self axis instead.

not-creating-element-correctly.message: xsl:element is used with a static name. Use a literal result element instead.

not-using-output.message: The xsl:output instruction is missing. Declare it to specify the serialization format explicitly.

output-method-xml.message: xsl:output declares method='xml' while the root template builds an HTML document. Change the method to 'html'.

predicate-position-literal.message: A positional predicate is written the long way; [position() = N] is just [N] and [position() = last()] is just [last()]. Shorten it.

redundant-boolean-call.message: A boolean() call stands where nothing but a truth is taken, so the wrapper is redundant. Drop it.

redundant-double-negation.message: A double negation not(not(x)) is redundant; it is just boolean(x), and where nothing but a truth is taken simply x. Replace it.

redundant-import.message: The stylesheet imports or includes the same module more than once. Keep a single xsl:import/xsl:include of it and remove the other.

redundant-namespace-declarations.message: The xsl:stylesheet declares a namespace prefix that nothing in it uses. Remove the declaration, or exclude the prefix where a literal result element copies it out.

redundant-whitespace.message: An XPath expression has redundant whitespace. Remove the extra spaces.

scans-whole-document.message: An expression opens a path with //, which scans the whole document each time it runs. Name the path, use xsl:key, or bind the scan once in a top-level variable.

starts-with-double-slash.message: A pattern alternative opens with //, which at most demands a document-node root. Drop it, and set an explicit priority if the template must rank as before.

string-length-compared-to-zero.message: string-length(...) is compared with 0 to test emptiness, which measures the whole string. Compare the value with '' instead.

template-writes-nothing.message: This template declares variables and writes nothing to the result tree, so applying it produces nothing. Write the output it was meant to build, or empty it.

translate-for-case.message: translate() folds case over the ASCII alphabet alone. Use lower-case() or upper-case(), which are shorter and Unicode-aware.

unabbreviated-axis.message: Verbose axis specifiers child::, attribute::, parent::node(), or self::node() are used. Replace them with the node name alone, @, .., or . respectively.

undefined-variable.message: A variable is referenced where no binding in scope declares it. Declare it, or correct the name to one in scope.

unused-function-template-parameter.message: A parameter is declared but never referenced in the function or template body. Remove it or use it.

use-double-slash.message: A pattern contains //, which matches at any depth and is broader than intended. Use a specific path.

use-node-set-extension.message: The node-set() extension function is unnecessary in XSLT 2.0 and later. Query the variable directly without it.

using-namespace-axis.message: The namespace:: axis is deprecated in XSLT 2.0 and later. Use in-scope-prefixes() and namespace-uri-for-prefix() instead.

invalid-xpath-expression.message: An XPath expression is malformed and cannot be parsed. Fix its syntax.

malformed-stylesheet.message: The stylesheet is not well-formed XML and cannot be parsed. Fix its syntax.
malformed-stylesheet.namespace: The stylesheet uses a namespace prefix it never declares, so it cannot be parsed. Declare the prefix with its namespace URI, or rename it if it is reserved.

syntax-newer-than-xslt-version.message: This XPath syntax belongs to a later XSLT version than the one in force, so a conformant processor rejects it. Raise the version, or respell the construct.

blank-nested-if.message: An xsl:if holds nothing but another xsl:if, stating one condition in two places. Combine the tests with 'and' in one xsl:if, unless the outer test guards the inner one.

duplicate-param-name.xpath: //xsl:param[some $sibling in preceding-sibling::xsl:param satisfies xslint:name($sibling, 'name') = xslint:name(., 'name') and not(xslint:conditional($sibling) or xslint:conditional(.))]
duplicate-param-name.message: Two xsl:param siblings share a @name. Each parameter of a template, function, or stylesheet must have a distinct name.

duplicate-with-param-name.xpath: //xsl:with-param[some $sibling in preceding-sibling::xsl:with-param satisfies xslint:attribute($sibling, 'name') = xslint:attribute(., 'name') and not(xslint:conditional($sibling) or xslint:conditional(.))]
duplicate-with-param-name.message: A single call passes two xsl:with-param with the same @name. Each parameter can be supplied only once.

empty-choose.message: An xsl:choose has no xsl:when branch. Add one, or drop the xsl:choose and keep its content directly.

empty-content-in-instructions.message: An instruction element such as xsl:for-each or xsl:if has no content. Add content or remove the empty element.

empty-variable.xpath: //xsl:variable[not(@select) and not(@_select) and not(node()) and (not(@as or @_as) or xslint:version(.) < 2.0)]
empty-variable.message: An empty xsl:variable binds the empty string without saying so. State the value with select="''" or give it some content.

function-complexity.message: The function contains more than 50 XSLT elements. Split it into smaller functions.

function-template-is-not-child-of-styles.message: An xsl:function or xsl:template is nested inside another element. Move it up to the top level, as a child of the stylesheet element.

function-use-in-xslt-1.message: An xsl:function requires XSLT 2.0 or later, and the version in force here is below that. Use a named template, or raise that version to 2.0.

incorrect-use-of-boolean-constants.message: The test is the string 'true' or 'false', a non-empty string that is always true, not a boolean. Use true() or false() instead.

malformed-version-in-stylesheet.message: A declared version is not a decimal number, so it names no XSLT version and every check gated on one stays quiet. Declare it as a decimal, such as 2.0.

missing-id-in-stylesheet.message: The stylesheet element has no @id attribute. Declare it to specify the unique identifier explicitly.

missing-or-empty-href.message: The @href is missing or empty, so this pulls in no module and no processor will load the stylesheet. Name the module to pull in.

missing-or-empty-name.xpath: //(xsl:variable | xsl:param | xsl:call-template | xsl:function | xsl:key | xsl:attribute-set | xsl:character-map | xsl:accumulator | xsl:element | xsl:attribute | xsl:processing-instruction | xsl:namespace)[not(@name) and not(@_name)] | //(xsl:variable | xsl:param | xsl:with-param | xsl:call-template | xsl:template | xsl:function | xsl:key | xsl:attribute-set | xsl:decimal-format | xsl:character-map | xsl:mode | xsl:accumulator | xsl:element | xsl:attribute)[xslint:attribute(., 'name') = '']
missing-or-empty-name.message: The @name is missing or empty, so it holds no QName and no processor will load this stylesheet. Give it a name.

missing-version-in-stylesheet.xpath: /*[if (self::xsl:*) then (not(@version) and not(@_version)) else (not(@xsl:version) and .//xsl:* and not(.//(xsl:stylesheet | xsl:transform | xsl:package)))] | /*[not(self::xsl:*)]//(xsl:stylesheet | xsl:transform | xsl:package)[not(@version) and not(@_version)]
missing-version-in-stylesheet.message: The version attribute is missing on the stylesheet's root element. Declare it to specify the stylesheet version explicitly.

mode-or-priority-without-match.xpath: //xsl:template[(@name or @_name) and not(@match) and not(@_match) and (@mode or @_mode or @priority or @_priority)]
mode-or-priority-without-match.message: An xsl:template that has no match attribute must have no mode attribute and no priority attribute. Add match attribute or remove mode or priority.

modern-construct-in-xslt-1.xpath: //(xsl:for-each-group | xsl:sequence | xsl:analyze-string | xsl:next-match | xsl:perform-sort | xsl:namespace | xsl:character-map | xsl:result-document | xsl:import-schema | xsl:*[(@as or @_as) and not(self::xsl:function)])[xslint:version(.) < 2.0]
modern-construct-in-xslt-1.message: This XSLT 2.0 construct stands where the version in force is below 2.0, which a conformant 1.0 processor rejects. Use a 1.0 equivalent, or raise that version to 2.0.

name-starts-with-numeric.message: A variable, parameter, function, or template name starts with a digit, so no processor loads this stylesheet. Rename it to start with a letter.

not-creating-attribute-correctly.xpath: //xsl:attribute[not(contains(@name, '{')) and not(@_name)][not(@namespace) and not(@_namespace)][parent::*[not(self::xsl:*)]][not(*) or (count(*) = 1 and (xsl:value-of[not(@separator) and not(@_separator)] or xsl:text[not(@disable-output-escaping) and not(@_disable-output-escaping)]))][not(preceding-sibling::*[not(self::xsl:variable) and not(self::xsl:attribute)])][not(preceding-sibling::xsl:attribute[@_name or not(@name) or contains(@name, '{')])][not(preceding-sibling::xsl:attribute/xslint:attribute(., 'name') = xslint:attribute(., 'name'))][not(some $held in ../@*[not(namespace-uri() = 'http://www.w3.org/1999/XSL/Transform')] satisfies local-name($held) = replace(xslint:attribute(., 'name'), '^.*:', ''))][not(@separator) and not(@_separator) and not(@type) and not(@_type) and not(@validation) and not(@_validation)][not(some $value in (. | .//@select | .//@_select) satisfies preceding-sibling::xsl:variable[contains($value, concat('$', xslint:attribute(., 'name')))])]
not-creating-attribute-correctly.message: xsl:attribute with a static name on a literal element can be a literal attribute (an AVT for a computed value). Write it inline.

not-using-attribute-test-in-if-when-node.message: An xsl:if or xsl:when has no @test attribute. Add one, or remove the element.

otherwise-not-last.message: An xsl:otherwise must be the last child of its xsl:choose. Move it after every xsl:when.

oversized-template.message: The template contains more than 100 XSLT elements. Decompose it with apply-templates into focused templates.

param-after-content.message: An xsl:param must be declared before any other content in its xsl:template or xsl:function. Move it above the content.

setting-value-of-variable-incorrectly.xpath: //(xsl:variable | xsl:param | xsl:with-param)[not(@select) and not(@_select) and (count(*) = 1) and (count(xsl:value-of[@select or @_select][not(@separator) and not(@_separator)]) = 1) and not(text()[xslint:normalize-space(.) or ancestor::*[@xml:space][1]/@xml:space = 'preserve'])]
setting-value-of-variable-incorrectly.message: A variable or parameter is assigned via a nested xsl:value-of instead of the select attribute. Use select syntax instead.

short-names.message: A variable, parameter, function, or template has a single-character name. Use a descriptive name that reveals intent.

sort-not-first.message: An xsl:sort must come before any other content in its xsl:for-each or xsl:apply-templates. Move it to the front.

stylesheet-has-no-templates.message: The stylesheet declares nothing at all, so it contributes nothing to a transformation. Add a declaration to it.

template-has-no-name-or-match.xpath: //xsl:template[not(@name) and not(@_name) and not(@match) and not(@_match)]
template-has-no-name-or-match.message: An xsl:template must have a @match or @name attribute, or both. Add one of them.

text-outside-xsl-text.message: Literal text appears directly inside an XSLT instruction element. Wrap it in xsl:text.

too-many-templates.message: The stylesheet declares 10 or more templates, too many to read in one file. Split it into imported modules.

use-choose-without-otherwise.message: xsl:choose has no xsl:otherwise branch. Add xsl:otherwise to handle unmatched cases explicitly.

use-single-option-for-choose.message: xsl:choose contains only one xsl:when branch. Replace it with xsl:if.

using-disable-output-escaping.message: disable-output-escaping='yes' is set, which produces implementation-defined output. Use xsl:copy-of or literal elements instead.

using-not-outermost-stylesheet.message: An xsl:stylesheet, xsl:transform or xsl:package is nested inside another element. It must be the outermost element of the document.

variable-or-param-with-select-and-conten.xpath: //(xsl:variable | xsl:param | xsl:with-param)[(@select or @_select) and (* or text()[xslint:normalize-space(.) or ancestor::*[@xml:space][1]/@xml:space = 'preserve'])]
variable-or-param-with-select-and-conten.message: An xsl:variable, xsl:param or xsl:with-param has both a select attribute and a non-empty body. Use only one way to set the value.

when-or-otherwise-outside-choose.message: An xsl:when or xsl:otherwise is valid only as a child of xsl:choose. Move it into an xsl:choose, or use xsl:if.

with-param-use-in-invalid-parent-node.xpath: //xsl:with-param[not(parent::xsl:call-template or parent::xsl:apply-templates or parent::xsl:apply-imports or parent::xsl:next-match or parent::xsl:next-iteration or parent::xsl:evaluate)] | //xsl:with-param[parent::xsl:apply-imports][xslint:version(.) < 2.0]
with-param-use-in-invalid-parent-node.message: xsl:with-param stands under an element taking no parameters at the version in force, which a processor of that version refuses. Move it into a call, or raise the version.

with-param-without-name.message: xsl:with-param requires a @name attribute to bind the parameter it passes. Add one.
